LVIS-92i gallery: random queries, text-only vs. text + CMAS (SAM3)

Classes: thermometer, flashlight, pastry, gravy boat, dinghy (the classes of the released steering packs; 5 annotated support images per class, supports excluded). Within these classes the queries are a random sample (seed 2027) of the LVIS-92i val queries, not hand-picked, plus random images where the class is absent. Present: mean Dice text-only 0.08 → text + CMAS 0.79 (22 queries; queries with Dice > 0: 2 → 19). Absent: correct empty output 10/10 → 10/10. The pack classes were chosen as showcase classes where text-only SAM3 fails, so this gallery is not representative of the dataset average (LVIS-92i: Dice 0.545 → 0.657 over all classes, paper Table 2). Masks re-predicted with the released code and packs (not the paper's saved outputs).

Ground truth

Text-only

Text + CMAS

Keys: ←/→ previous/next, ↑/↓ previous/next class. Images are downscaled to at most 384 px (JPEG); masks are the binary default outputs (score > 0.5), exact at that resolution. Dice / IoU in the panel titles are computed at full resolution.

Images: COCO 2017 (Flickr; per-image licence shown under the panels); annotations: LVIS v1 (Gupta et al., CVPR 2019), CC BY 4.0. Shown for research illustration.
